subject: Tracing contract & runbook alignment — CloudWave integration
messages:
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodai.com>
To: Sofie Chen <sofie.chen@cloudwave.com>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwoodai.com, marissa_cole@redwoodai.com, marcus_lin@redwoodai.com
Date: Tue, 28 May 2029 08:15:00 -0700
Subject: Tracing contract & runbook alignment — CloudWave integration

Hi Sofie —

Thanks again for the intro call last week. To keep momentum we want to lock down a short, practical "trace contract" and the onboarding runbook we will use during implementation. Goal: make the cutover observable for your SREs and ours on day one.

Proposed agenda for a 45-minute working session (we can split if helpful):
- Trace contract: required spans, tags, and sampling expectations
- Dashboard wireframes: key KPIs, error rates, latency P95/P99 by operation
- Alert routing: who owns which alerts and primary escalation steps
- Runbook outline: triage flow, rollback criteria, escalation playbook
- Deliverables & owners: runbook draft, trace-mapping spreadsheet, dashboard mockups

Attached initial artifacts (very rough): runbook-draft-v1.pdf, trace-mapping.xlsx, dashboard-wireframe.png.

Can you confirm who from CloudWave will attend and whether Wednesday 5/29 10:00-10:45 PT or Thursday 5/30 09:00-09:45 PT works?

Thanks — looking forward to getting this ironed out.

Jonas Weber
Manager, Customer Success — Observability
Redwood Inference
---
Attachments:
- runbook-draft-v1.pdf (26 KB) — draft runbook skeleton
- trace-mapping.xlsx (18 KB) — span/name mapping template
- dashboard-wireframe.png (145 KB) — mockup sketches
From: Sofie Chen <sofie.chen@cloudwave.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodai.com>
Cc: CloudWave Implementations <implementations@cloudwave.com>, laura_bennett@redwoodai.com
Date: Tue, 28 May 2029 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Tracing contract & runbook alignment — CloudWave integration

Jonas —

Thanks for sending this over and for the clear agenda. I will be joined by our Integration Lead (email above) and one of our SREs, Raj Patel (raj.patel@cloudwave.com). Quick clarifications from our side:
- Sampling: we prefer 100% for request traces during rollout windows but can move to 10% after stabilization.
- Dashboards: please include a per-endpoint error taxonomy column — we need to be able to tell service vs payload vs auth failures at a glance.

Both times you proposed work for us; Wednesday 5/29 10:00 PT is slightly better. We'll accept the invite once you send it.

A couple of ask items before the session if possible:
- Can you flag which spans in trace-mapping.xlsx are required vs optional?
- If you have a short example runbook (play-by-play triage) that matches your internal SRE flow that would be helpful.

Best,
Sofie
Head of Integrations
CloudWave

Morning —

Quick prep notes for the workshop:
- Alert routing: suggest we own high-severity (P0/P1) incidents for the API gateway and page CloudWave SREs for application errors that are clearly downstream. We'll add explicit PagerDuty escalation chains in the runbook.
- Error taxonomy: I'll add three buckets to the dashboard mock: service_error, client_error, validation_error. Each bucket will expand to example error codes for CloudWave APIs.
- Tracing: Marcus will flag 6 required spans (proxy.receive, proxy.dispatch, auth.check, service.call, db.query, response.render). I'll mark which need full payload sampling for the rollout window.

I'll be on the call at 10:00 PT and will bring the dashboard PNG and a short slide of example runs.

Marissa
Customer Success Engineer
Redwood Inference
